_about: Everyday agent jobs for comparing tool surfaces (separate tools vs one bash tool, settings.toolSurface): run with tests/eval/run.mjs --set tasks-tools.json [--surface bash]. One fresh chat each, in order (task 3 reads the clone task 2 made). `file`: a file that must exist afterwards and match.

cases.name: Clone a repo and read its README
messages: Clone github.com/tester/app and tell me what its README says

cases.name: Read a file in a clone
messages: What does src/index.js in /repos/app print when it runs?

cases.name: Write a file
messages: Save a note in my home folder called todo.md that says: buy milk

cases.name: Read a page the user gave
messages: Read https://example.com and tell me what it says
